analysis_not_paper_claims: Action-conditioned prediction does not establish intervention-effect identifiability in confounded observational IT data.
Temporal causal attention and task-token isolation do not constitute causal identification guarantees.
IT migration requires action-aligned trajectories, delayed/failed operation records and evaluation of actual recovery outcomes; RCA labels alone do not supply these trajectories.
Model-internal policy improvement, predictive quality and real-system execution benefit require separate evaluation.
Production safety and cloud deployment benefits are not demonstrated by these game/simulation results.
